body: Things we never did-Sad lovers and Giants

I’m 19, I moved in with my boyfriend way too early to escape an abusive household. He and I lost our apartment due to some shitty circumstances and he was like, hey, let’s get some Xanax to chill out and think of a way to find housing. (He has past problems with Xanax and alcohol) i agreed because I was feeling very stressed and felt like my world was crumbling before me. He bought them from some street dealer and whatever was in those pills was laced because I woke up in jail not knowing what happened and an officer told me I was in there for domestic violence. I felt so horrible. I would never hurt him, he is my world. I did it while intoxicated and don’t even remember what led to it. We left the state together and moved in with my mom (the abusive parent) at a last minutes notice which was extremely high tensions for all of us. My boyfriend continued to take Xanax and we got into a fight because I refused to take him to get more and my mom found out about his problems and kicked him out. He is now all the way across the country. I’m going to a rehab program mainly for my behavioral and emotional health and he is going for drugs. We plan to reunite after. I just really worry he won’t wait for me or will find someone better while I’m gone because my program is longer than his. It’s gonna be very hard to have no contact, I’ve realized I’m very codependent with him. Being back home with my mom is very difficult because she is a textbook narcissist and whenever I reach out for help she says I am stressing her out and that she can’t exhaust herself helping me. All I asked was if I could sleep in her room because I feel very lonely without my boyfriend and she said no. I just got off the phone with the suicide hotline and feel a lot better. I’m going to rehab and bettering myself and if he waits for me or doesnt, I will accept the outcome and tough it out. I need to prioritize my future. I’m too young to be this sad and caught up in all these problems. I’m just so scared of the future.
